name: Landless One
description: Aslan who fail to find their place in Glorious Empire society do not become Outcasts as they do in the Hierate. Instead, they become Landless Ones — looked down upon as the scum of society but filling several crucial roles in the Empire's underworld economy.

labourer.name: Labourer
labourer.description: You work in a dead-end job, often alongside human slaves.

wildcatter.name: Wildcatter
wildcatter.description: You are a scavenger and resource hunter, retrieving derelict starships or mining asteroids, comets and gas giants.

trader.name: Trader
trader.description: You are a black marketeer, operating on the fringes of the Empire to supply goods it desperately needs.

slaver.name: Slaver
slaver.description: You raid foreign star systems for human slaves.

mishaps.1: Severely injured. Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.
mishaps.2: Your friends desert you. Lose an Ally or Contact. If you have none, lose all Benefits for this term.
mishaps.3: Your ship crashes on a hostile world. Gain any one of Survival 1, Mechanic 1, Animals 1 or Recon 1.
mishaps.4: You suffer a life-threatening disease or starvation and lose END −1.
mishaps.5: A rival sabotages your ship. Gain Mechanic from the experience of fixing it and gain him as a Rival.
mishaps.6: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: You find a cache of valuable supplies and make a tidy profit on the black market. Gain 1D Benefit rolls, Streetwise 1 or Broker 1.
events.4: Without help or available spare parts, you learn to do it yourself. Gain Jack-of-All-Trades.
events.5: You cross the border into Hierate or human space for a job and get to know the locals. Gain Tolerance and one of the following: Persuade 1, Deception 1, Independence 1 or a Contact.
events.6: You are given advanced training in a specialist field. Roll EDU 8+ to gain any skill except Jack-of-All-Trades.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Aslan Life Events table.
events.8: You pick up some useful shipboard skills. Gain one of Pilot (Spacecraft), Gunner (Turret), Engineer or Mechanic.
events.9: You have to recruit to fill positions in your crew. Gain Carouse, Streetwise or Persuade and an additional roll on the Cash Benefits table.
events.10: You come into conflict with a rival team. Roll Melee 8+ or Deception 8+. If you succeed, gain an Ally from your crew. If you fail, lose your Benefit roll for this term and gain an Enemy.
events.11: Your clan offers you a chance at redemption. You may restore your SOC to its original value and attempt to qualify for another career next term, but you owe a great debt to a clan elder, whom you gain as a Contact.
events.12: You are conscripted to fight as a warrior grunt in the battles of the Empire. You automatically qualify for the Warrior career and must serve at least one term.
